identity.title: Submillimeter polarization and variability of quasar PKS 1830-211

paper_type_evidence.quote: PKS 1830$-$211 has previously been observed with ALMA, primarily to study the molecular absorption arising from the foreground lensing galaxy (cite: mul14). However, we have also used these observations to study the AGN variability and polarization as a byproduct.

evidence.quote: PKS 1830$-$211 is a gravitationally lensed quasar at a redshift of $z=2.5$ ((cite: lid99)).
PKS 1830$-$211 is a gravitationally lensed quasar at a redshift of $z=2.5$ ((cite: lid99)).

question.value: What are the submm polarization, rotation measure and short-term variability of the lensed quasar PKS 1830-211, using differential polarimetry on dual-polarization ALMA data?

evidence.quote: we use the flux-density ratios between lensed images to analyze the short-term (intra-hour) source variability, and we use the $\psi$ dependence on $R_{pol}$ to analyze the source polarization.
we use complementary observations at Bands 7 and 8 (at frequencies between 300 and 500 GHz) to constrain the Faraday rotation.

analysis_steps.goal: Measure flux densities of NE and SW images per polarization and time bin

method.value: Fit two point sources to visibilities in XX, YY, I in short time bins of a few minutes

validation.value: Consistency across bands and epochs; images checked

evidence.quote: The fact that we obtain the same qualitative behavior from data taken with two independent receiver bands and within a few hours indicates that our technique is robust.

analysis_steps.goal: Fit Rpol versus parallactic angle in Band 9

evidence.quote: R_{pol} = p_d \cos{\left[2(\psi + \beta + \phi_0)\right]}

assumptions.value: SW image unpolarized so p_d is NE polarization

evidence.quote: since the polarization of SW is negligible, the differential polarization corresponds to the absolute polarization of NE

method.value: Fix p_d and phi0 from Band 9, fit RM with multi-frequency Rpol model using May 19-20 data

evidence.quote: we can fix the differential polarimetry parameters in Band 9 (i.e., $p_d$ and $\phi_0$ in Eq. [\[RpolSine\]](#RpolSine)) and fit for $RM$ in the NE image
assuming a negligible change in the EVPA during this time range ($\sim$ 1 day)

results_numeric.quantity: NE/SW Stokes I ratio change in Band 9

evidence.quote: from a value of $\sim1.75$ (at 7:10 UT) to $\sim1.60$ (at 8:17 UT)

findings_qualitative.value: NE image polarized, SW unpolarized; RM in 2015 far lower than 2012-2014 values

evidence.quote: the $RM$ in May 2015 is much lower than the values on 2012/2014 reported by (cite: IMV2015)

claims.hypothesis: Differential polarimetry can recover polarization from dual-polarization ALMA data of PKS 1830-211
claims.experiment: Fit Rpol vs parallactic angle in Band 9
claims.finding: NE is polarized and SW is nearly unpolarized

evidence.quote: We estimate a fractional polarization of $p_d = (4.9 \pm 0.1)$% and an EVPA of $(80.3 \pm 1.3)$ deg. for the NE image.

claims.hypothesis: RM remains as high as in 2012-2014
claims.experiment: Fit RM with Bands 7-9 and compare Rpol slopes
claims.result: RM = (2.3±0.6)e5 rad m^-2, slopes compatible with zero
claims.finding: RM much lower in 2015; detection only tentative

evidence.quote: The detection of $RM$ in these data is thus only tentative

claims.hypothesis: Intra-hour variability is detectable in Band 9
claims.experiment: Track NE/SW flux ratio over one hour
claims.result: ~10% decrease in R_I mostly from SW increase

evidence.quote: This is a change of $\sim10$% in $R_I$, almost completely related to the change in flux density of SW

why_this_data.value: Archival ALMA observations offered the only Band 9 data over a wide parallactic angle range

evidence.quote: However, we have also used these observations to study the AGN variability and polarization as a byproduct.

limitations_admitted.value: Poor parallactic angle coverage in Bands 7/8 limits RM precision; EVPA variability could mimic RM

evidence.quote: The main reason for the high relative uncertainty in $RM$ is the poor parallactic-angle coverage of the data at Bands 7 and 8

referee_caveats_inferred: RM fit assumes constant EVPA over ~1 day while allowing for rapid variation
Fit method and error derivation not described
